name: Zahmar Tookes
strengths: Tookes gets off the ball with a quick first step and natural leverage for a long 6-3.5 frame.
Tookes uses active hands (swim/rip) to shed and create negative plays behind the line.
Tookes pursues with a hot motor sideline-to-sideline and finishes with closing speed for 260.
Tookes shows bend/flexibility to threaten from 3-tech or kicked-out edge alignments.
weaknesses: Tookes can play too upright at contact and needs cleaner hand placement so he does not lunge through rushes.
comparison: Tookes comps to Ed Oliver -- athletic interior DL with first-step burst and active hands in a long, explosive mold (Tookes listed 6-3.5 / 260 with room to grow into that family).
projection: Tookes projects as develop into the DL room, earn early rotation snaps as a disruptive 3-tech/4i, then compete for a starting interior role -- starter upside as a quick-twitch run-and-pass disruptor.
schemeFit: Tookes fits White's front as a penetrating interior who can also flex to 5-tech in odd looks.
insiderNotes: Vault film desk on Zahmar Tookes via On3->Hudl (Brighton 2025 junior season): 6-3.5 / 260 DL out of Rochester, NY. Florida 2027 commit.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-05 from On3 Hudl embed. Comp size-matched within ~1-2" -- not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: Zahmar Tookes is a 4-star DL | listed 6-3.5 / 260 | Brighton (Rochester, NY) | Florida 2027 commit.
angle: Lead with junior Brighton Hudl first-step and shed ability on the interior.
